semiconductor_relevance: High — XTPL specializes in ultra-precision dispensing systems that are critical for advanced microelectronics manufacturing.
summary: XTPL is a leader in ultra-precision dispensing systems, focusing on industrial applications and R&D for microelectronics. Their innovative conductive nanomaterials and state-of-the-art delta printing technology enable high-resolution dispensing, supporting a wide range of substrates and viscosities.
capabilities: Ultra-precision dispensing systems with 1 μm resolution

regional_presence.Poland: Headquartered in Wrocław, Poland, XTPL drives innovation in microelectronics.
regional_presence.United States: Has a dedicated office in Boston, USA, to support its North American operations.
